targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, source_identity, payload FROM paper_orders ORDER BY session_id DESC
SELECT session_id, source_identity, payload FROM paper_fills ORDER BY session_id DESC

SELECT s.session_id, count(DISTINCT o.source_identity) AS order_count, count(DISTINCT f.source_identity) AS fill_count FROM paper_sessions s LEFT JOIN paper_orders o ON o.session_id=s.session_id LEFT JOIN paper_fills f ON f.session_id=s.session_id GROUP BY s.session_id
